rules-note: P and D business strikes only (plus W for the 2019-2020 America the Beautiful designs): no S coins of any kind (proof, silver proof, Uncirculated or Enhanced uncirculated), no silver bullion, no privy-mark specials. Every coin carries its mint mark. variety is the design name as displayed in the source. Mintages come only from the saved source; null where it gives no figure. Release order: designs in source order, then P, D (then W). isKeyDate is false throughout; no images. This file: the five Quarter rows of the "Circulating coinage" table of "United States Semiquincentennial coinage" (the 2026 program). Its Mintage columns are Denver, Philadelphia, San Francisco, West Point, Total (Denver first): P = Philadelphia, D = Denver. variety is the coin's design name, the Subject cell shortened from its linked article title ("American Revolutionary War" -> "Revolutionary War", "United States Declaration of Independence" -> "Declaration of Independence", "Constitution of the United States" -> "Constitution"). The Constitution and Gettysburg Address rows have empty mintage cells at this revision, so their four coins have mintage null. The 250,000 2026 "JULY 4th" privy-mark Declaration quarters without a mint mark are excluded.
name: Semiquincentennial Quarters
